summary: Frontend-only validation completed for the focused timeline cleanup on public URL. Desktop and tablet checks passed, but mobile layouts still show critical overlap/stacking issues at 390x844 and 320x700.

ui_bugs.issue: At 320x700, active year (2008) intersects the story region (year/story overlap=true), causing incoherent hero stacking.
At 390x844 and 320x700, right data panel starts before image zone ends (data below image condition failed), so critical content appears crowded/partially over image zone.

issues: Visual hierarchy remains compressed with year, story, and stats tightly stacked in same vertical band
Mobile readability degrades due to insufficient spacing between image/story/data zones

action_items: Adjust mobile breakpoints (<=430px and short-height) so timeline data container starts strictly below image region.
Prevent active year lockup from entering story block on 320x700 by revising top offsets/font scaling for year and story nodes.
Re-run viewport matrix at 390x844 and 320x700 after CSS adjustments.
critical_code_review_comments: Desktop fixes are effective: 2008 state at 1920x800 shows no year/story, year/data, or story/data overlap.
Era spine relocation is successful: compact horizontal strip remains above navigation and does not cross achievement rows.
All 19 season images load with nonzero natural dimensions; portrait/landscape frame mapping matches requested contain/cover rules.
Rapid year/tab stress keeps a single active image/story/data node and no duplicate test-id driven active artifacts.
Reduced-motion path is correct for scan element visibility (scan hidden).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated timeline via public URL with menu navigation + direct route checks. Route stop remains exact at 0.305, desktop/tablet representative years pass, telemetry simplification behaves, and controls (prev/next, year rail, arrows, tabs, era, theme, Legacy/Cars, Back to Circuit) work. Remaining failures are mobile layout stacking at 390x844 and 320x700.
rca of the issue: RCA: Mobile media-query positioning still places year lockup/story/data in overlapping vertical ranges for shorter/narrow viewports. Reproduction: open timeline, set 2008 + Podiums at 390x844 or 320x700. Observed: data panel top is not strictly below image bottom; at 320x700 year overlaps story. Likely cause is combined absolute positioning values in TimelineV2.css under max-width breakpoints (year/story/data top offsets and fixed image mask bounds) not fully rebalanced for short-height mobile.
